column1: # Austrian word or phrase -> the standard German word the sources (BLS) name it by.
# <word><TAB><german>[<TAB><german> ...] — each extra word is one more rewrite.
# A word is a stem: it also matches inside a compound (erdäpfel matches erdäpfelsalat);
# the longest match wins, so a more specific line overrides a stem.
# Austrian -> German only, never the reverse: words that are standard German already are
# not keys (and false friends keep their Austrian meaning — AT "Hörnchen" is the pasta).
